# Tournament Leaderboard

> Results, standings and statistics of community Valorant tournaments. Each organisation has its
> own pages at /o/{slug}; the first one is Alsace Arena, at /o/alsace-arena. The pages are an
> Angular app, so read the public JSON API below rather than the HTML.

Everything listed here is public and needs no sign-in. Please read it at a reasonable pace.
Valorant and Riot Games are trademarks of Riot Games, Inc.; this site isn't endorsed by them.

## Public API (JSON, GET only)

- [Organisation](/api/orgs/alsace-arena): its name and tournament
- [Seasons](/api/orgs/alsace-arena/seasons): every season and its number
- Season leaderboard: `/api/orgs/{slug}/seasons/{n}/leaderboard`, every player's points, wins and stats
- Season summary: `/api/orgs/{slug}/seasons/{n}/summary`, matches and games played, players, next match
- Scoring rules: `/api/orgs/{slug}/seasons/{n}/rules`, points per stat, per win and per bonus
- Matches: `/api/orgs/{slug}/seasons/{n}/matches` and `/api/orgs/{slug}/seasons/{n}/matches/{m}`
- [Ranks](/api/ranks): the Valorant ranks and their colours

Errors are JSON problem details (RFC 9457).

## Pages

- [Leaderboard](/o/alsace-arena): the season's podium, numbers, standings and scoring rules
- [Matches](/o/alsace-arena/matches)
- [Legal notice](/legal), [Privacy policy](/privacy), [Cookie policy](/cookies), [Terms of use](/terms)
